title: Learn app growth from seven operators actually shipping: who to follow and why
summary: Jake curates seven mobile app and subscription operators worth studying instead of courses or YouTube. He highlights concrete growth lessons: content-led distribution, ASO concentration on a few keywords, portfolio-of-simple-apps systems, and solo AI-assisted building.

principles.text: Learn from operators actively shipping and posting what works, not from courses or tutorial binges.
principles.quote: study these seven people who are _actually in the arena_, shipping apps, running profitable companies, and posting what works in real time.

principles.text: Write content that answers the exact questions your buyers are already Googling; it's a powerful distribution engine.
principles.quote: He grew it from $400/month to $2M ARR by writing content that answered the exact questions developers were Googling (an elite distribution lesson in itself).

principles.text: In paid search, downloads concentrate in a handful of keywords, so don't spread effort across hundreds.
principles.quote: even when you target hundreds of keywords in Apple Search Ads, most of your downloads come from just five to ten of them.

principles.text: You don't need a blockbuster app; a repeatable system of simple apps optimized for App Store discovery can win.
principles.quote: His entire approach is a repeatable system: find a niche, build simply, optimize for App Store discovery, and repeat.

principles.text: One person with AI tools and business sense can now build a real company with a tiny team.
principles.quote: one person with AI tools and business sense can build a real company.

principles.text: Onboarding and the early user experience determine whether someone churns or becomes a paying subscriber.
principles.quote: His specialty is onboarding and the early user experience, the exact moments that determine whether someone churns or becomes a paying subscriber.
